source.note: VERIFIED oracle text (oracle-cards.json, Elf Druid, {1}{G}, 0/2): line 0 '{T}: Add {G}.'  line 1 'Put a -1/-1 counter on this creature: Untap this creature.'  ALL FOUR ports parse FAITHFULLY in dumps/card-ports.json (no parse gap): consume tap:self (family=tap), emit:mana:green (family=mana, stem=mana), consume pay:putcounters (family=mana; the '-1/-1 counter' cost of line 1), emit:untap:self (family=untap, stem=structure:untap). This single-card gold witnesses the NEW self-untap-via-counter ARM: a counter-placement COST that emits a SELF-untap which renews the source's own tap-for-mana. Devoted Druid ALONE is a BOUNDED self-untap -- each untap costs a cumulative -1/-1 counter, so the 0/2 body dies at toughness 0 (CR 704.5f) after ~2 renewals (it produces a few extra {G}, not infinite). The famous INFINITE-green-mana combo needs an external -1/-1 remover/preventer -- Vizier of Remedies (replaces the -1/-1 with zero counters) or Swift Reconfiguration (makes it a noncreature so 0 toughness no longer kills it); that infinite is a PAIRWISE gold left for when the remover is authored. No edhrec/popularity datum in the testbed source -- popularity omitted (not fabricated).

judge.ref: interaction-judge PASS (accretion batch 9, 2026-07-17): 9/9 PASS, no false GREEN. GREEN-on-new-rule golds (Teysa policy:trigger-multiplier, Heliod policy:counter-supplies-cost) CR-sound; untap-renews-tap collapse ruled SOUND (one relation, GREEN ceiling, guard-floored edges); pili-pala untap-to-mana split ruled SOUND-DISTINCT (external-tapper vs intrinsic self-tap inference).

Devoted Druid.note: the {T} activation cost of '{T}: Add {G}.' (dump: consume tap:self, family=tap). THE loop-closing renewable resource: a tapped permanent can't be tapped again to pay {T} (CR 107.5), so the cost is spent until the source is untapped. Renewed in place by the self-untap emit (E2). Same shape as kiki K2 (stem=tap, attrs{self:true}).
'Add {G}.' the payoff of the mana ability (dump: emit:mana:green, stem=mana). One green mana into the pool (CR 106.4) per tap; each self-untap renewal buys another activation -> another {G}.

the activation cost of the untap ability -- 'Put a -1/-1 counter on this creature:' (dump: consume pay:putcounters). A cost (CR 118.1) that places a -1/-1 counter (CR 122.1/122.6) on the source ITSELF. SELF-WEAKENING and CUMULATIVE -- this is the boundedness driver: the -1/-1 counters accrue and reduce toughness until the 0/2 body dies at toughness 0 (CR 704.5f). SURFACED SCAFFOLD NOTE: counter-type value '-1/-1' is not yet in the closed counter-type enum (values_seen only '+1/+1') -- a needed minor enum-value extension (a new VALUE on an existing axis, not a new axis); the flow accretes it into values_seen.

'Untap this creature.' the effect of the untap ability (dump: emit:untap:self, family=untap, stem=structure:untap). Flips the source's tapped status back to untapped (CR 110.5), so {T} (DD_TAP) is payable again (CR 107.5). Deterministic (no 'may') and SAME-OBJECT (object identity certain -- 'this creature' is the source), so no guard:self-watch applies. Contrast deadeye PD2 (structure:untap of LANDS, attrs{subtype:land}); here the untap is of SELF.

notes: the {T} tap cost (DD_TAP) drives the 'Add {G}' effect (DD_MANA) -- the card-internal cost->effect wiring of the mana ability (CR 602.1). Structural/self-certifying (cf. kiki E0 K2->K1). GREEN, no rule.

the counter-placement cost (DD_CTR) drives the 'Untap this creature' effect (DD_UNTAP) -- the card-internal cost->effect wiring of the untap ability (CR 602.1/118.1). Structural/self-certifying. GREEN, no rule.

THE SELF-UNTAP-VIA-COUNTER RENEWAL (the witness). Untapping the source IN PLACE (DD_UNTAP) flips its tapped status back to untapped (CR 110.5), renewing the {T} cost DD_TAP (CR 107.5). The single hop is RELIABLE on the merits -- deterministic (no 'may') and same-object (certain identity, no self-watch Overlap). It is AMBER, never GREEN, for TWO reasons: (i) the irreducible co-cost -- the untap's activation cost accrues a cumulative -1/-1 counter (guard:untap-cost-accrues-counter), so on the source alone the arm is BOUNDED: the 0/2 body dies at toughness 0 (CR 704.5f) after ~2 renewals -> no closed infinite loop; (ii) ladder -- bridge:untap-renews-tap is a NEW rule at status `observed` (judge PENDING), and a GREEN edge may rest only on a `confirmed` rule, so the ladder caps this to AMBER regardless of merits.

guards.desc: the self-untap's activation cost places a cumulative -1/-1 counter on the source (CR 118.1 cost / 122.1 counter), permanently weakening it each renewal; a creature reaching toughness 0 or less is put into its graveyard as a state-based action (CR 704.5f). So a self-untap loop closed by this counter cost carries an irreducible -1/-1 'toughness-budget' co-cost -- BOUNDED by the source's starting toughness on its own, no closed infinite cycle. The loop is GREEN-eligible (truly infinite) only when an external effect refills that budget: a -1/-1 counter remover/preventer (Vizier of Remedies replaces the -1/-1 with zero counters) or a noncreature-type change (Swift Reconfiguration -- 704.5f then no longer applies). The counter analogue of guard:recast-pays-mana (a mana co-cost that floors a loop unless the resource is provably refilled) -- the section-8/SDF co-cost cap for the self-untap-via-counter arm.

bridges.desc: an untap (structure:untap emit) renews a tap-based cost/ability (tap consume): the untapped permanent's {T} activated ability or tap-cost becomes available again (CR 701.26 untap keyword action; CR 107.5 the {T} cost; CR 602 re-activation). Ceiling GREEN -- a mandatory, universal untap reliably renews the tap (witnessed by Intruder Alarm's 'untap all creatures'); individual edges floor to AMBER via their own residual guards: object-identity Overlap on a targeted untap (guard:self-watch) or a cumulative counter co-cost (guard:untap-cost-accrues-counter). Collapses the batch-9 per-outlet siblings (ETB-targeted / universal-creature / self-via-counter) into one relation -- the differences are the untap's trigger/target (far side of the emit), not the untap->tap bridge.

assertions.because: the self-untap renewal is deterministic + same-object (reliable single hop), but its activation cost accrues a cumulative -1/-1 counter (guard:untap-cost-accrues-counter) that kills the 0/2 source at toughness 0 (CR 704.5f) -> bounded, no infinite loop; and the new bridge is `observed` (judge PENDING) so the ladder caps GREEN->AMBER regardless

first structure:untap[self] -> tap renewal: a counter-placement-cost-driven SELF-untap that renews the source's own tap-for-mana IN PLACE. Distinct from bridge:untap-land-to-mana (structure:untap -> mana, untaps OTHER lands cross-resource) and bridge:blink-renews-tap (deployment:creature[manner=blink] -> tap, renews via an optional blink re-entry)
the {T} tap cost drives the 'Add {G}' effect -- card-internal cost->effect wiring, structural/self-certifying (CR 602.1)
the counter-placement cost drives the 'Untap this creature' effect -- card-internal cost->effect wiring, structural/self-certifying (CR 602.1/118.1)
